mediumFindings.resolution: Removed the bundle normalizer and its test. The build now preserves raw esbuild output, including template-literal bytes. .gitattributes disables Git's blank-at-eol warning only for pi-extensions/pi-claude-bridge/bundle/*.js.
validation: git check-attr reports whitespace=-blank-at-eol only for the generated bridge bundle files

mediumFindings.reason: The approved requirement keys rebuild filtering to the selected consuming model and explicitly keeps other-model rebuild behavior unchanged. A producer-keyed filter would change approved behavior and requires a separate spec delta.
mediumFindings.residualRisk: After a model switch away from Fable 5.1, a later rebuild for another model can replay thinking blocks produced by Fable 5.1. This path is not claimed fixed or live-validated by this change.

minorFindings: Executable version inspection remains uncached but stayed within the approved 500 ms p95 threshold.
Executable candidate enumeration remains duplicated between the general and Fable 5.1 paths.
The no-candidate diagnostic uses a bundled-executable sentinel.
The installed-bundle unit check depends on the platform optional package.
